title: A Novel Respiratory Rate Estimation Algorithm from Photoplethysmogram Using Deep Learning Model
summary: Photoplethysmography model estimates respiratory rate with comparative validation. The result is limited to the reported study population and evaluation; the source does not establish transfer to other populations or improved clinical outcomes.
organization: Department of Mechatronics and Biomedical Engineering, Lee Kong Chian Faculty of Engineering and Science, Universiti Tunku Abdul Rahman, Kajang 43000, Selangor, Malaysia

evidence.unknown: The study does not establish improved patient outcomes or generalization beyond the evaluated setting.
